book.name: MATAIYO
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Mataiyo wana Leleli

content: Diyon Tobabitaiso wana Papaatena
Saugena o Diyon Tobabitaiso i nem ge i papaatena labi Yudiya wali ula gamwanaa labi kekevana elana.
I ba, “Wami pagan nanakina ana en nuku pek, kaiwena Yehoba wana abalogugui ana sauga i kelaubwa.”
Diyon bana te palopita Aiseya i baunan sauga toto i ba:

content.text: Gamagal etega to i yogayoga uleya labi kekevana elana, i ba,

content: Diyon ana kaliko heiya kaliko toto kamel pupunona elana hi ginoliya ge henuwanina ana wasikewa bulumakau kunisina elana hi ginoliya. Aana heiya sagagai
ge luvi toto uleya.
Gamagalau hi nem elana hi neem Yelusalema, hi neem Yudiya labena gegewena, ge labi gegewena toto wewel Yolidani labenaa.
Wali gegi hi wasaan inoke i pababitaisol wewel Yolidani elana.
Boda Palisi ge boda Sadiusi hi gewi i kitel hi nenem tage ni pababitaisol, inoke i baek elal i ba, “Komiu ku ola mwata! Henala i baewa eliyamiu ge nuwamiu Yehoba wana lahi toto i nenem nuku louwi?
Ebo tunahot wami gegi iyaka ana en ku pek, he enona ni masal yawalimiu elana.
Bahi nuku nuwatu tage nuku ba, ‘Ama tamama Abalahama, bosowaima ya te Yehoba wana lahi naha louwi.’ Na ba eliyamiu Yehoba i bosowaina pat ya ni ahel ge Abalahama tubunau ni ginolil.
He wana kenumu iyaka i lovivina-an ebwakil ewahililiya ni gotomwa ge nihi maguli. Ebwakil gegewel bolo enowaliya nige i wawaisi ni govel ge ni yoho tukagil ginaha elana.

“Nau ya pababitaisomiu wewel elana kaiwena wami pagan nanakina ana en iyaka ku pek. Yaa toto i nenem ewa, iya alana i bwata, nau alau nige i bwabwata. Nau nige no waisi i gagan ge tage bosowaiu aena ana os na kalivai. He iya abwe ni pababitaisomiu Yayaluwa Bwabwalena ge ginaha elana.

Wana sobel iyoho i pihikan nimanaa, yaka i tetelipuna wana witi enona alona ge musana ni ase, inoke abwe enona hot ni bugulan ni teliya wana gonuwa, ge musana ni ton ginaha elana toto nige sauga etega ni bobolu.”
Diyon Yeisu I Pababitaiso
Saugena o Yeisu i neem Galili i na wewel Yolidani, inoke i baek Diyon elana i ba, “Nu pababitaisowau.”
Yaa Diyon nuwana Yeisu wana nuwatu ni pil, yaka i ba, “Binimala owa te nu pababitaisowau. Ga i ola ge u nem elau?”
Anana Yeisu i lahe i ba, “Sauga e ta ginol ni ola ga no nuwatu. Ebo ta ola o, nasi Yehoba wana nuwatu ta paolaolaek.” Inoke Diyon i talam.
Diyon Yeisu i pababitaiso yaka Yeisu i gaihem wewela. Inoke sauga o labulabum i mwapwela ge Yehoba Yayaluwana i kite i ola bunibuni i laulau i nem elana.
Yaka anan etega i loem labulabumwa i ba, “Toto ya iya natu nunuwanina hot; ya yaliyaya nabiyan iya kaiwena.”

footnotes.text: Ta ba “sagagai” o ebo ta ba “koninib”.
